name: Altus rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 262 g for the Altus LT RD-AT12 short-cage rear derailleur, excluding the mounting bracket/adapter as expressly stated in the catalogue. It is not the long-cage RD-AT22 or the later MTB Altus families.

technical_document.title: Shimano RD-AT12 manufacturer exploded view: model identification, series and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano RD-AT12 manufacturer exploded view: model identification, series and replacement parts
Original Shimano catalogue archived as 1981, printed p. 38 / PDF p. 39: Altus/Selecta RD-AT12, 262 g without bracket, 13T front difference, 28T general / 30T Shimano-only largest sprocket.

specifications.reference_configuration: General sprocket compatibility: 28T maximum; the separate 30T allowance requires Shimano sprockets.
